entities.description: Grimsrud exits the passenger seat and Carl exits the driver's seat of a brown Ciera with dealer plates, arriving at a secluded lakeside cabin, bringing Jean with them.

entities.description: Grimsrud opens the back door of the car and, with a hand on her elbow, assists Jean—who has her hands tied behind her and a black hood over her head—out onto the driveway.

entities.name: Jean collapses and weeps in the snow
entities.description: After lurching in an arbitrary direction and losing balance while going downhill, Jean falls face-first into the snow and begins weeping, muffled by the hood over her head.

entities.name: Carl laughs at Jean's struggle in the snow
entities.description: Carl watches Jean's disoriented movements and fall with amusement, laughing loudly and exclaiming 'Jesus!' in response to her suffering.

entities.name: Grimsrud retrieves Jean after she falls
entities.description: After breaking free from Carl's restraint, Grimsrud walks out into the snow to capture and retrieve Jean following her failed escape attempt.

document_metadata.summary: Jerry discusses a $750,000 real estate deal with Wade, seeking approval for a parking lot on 40 acres, while Wade questions the investment and process.

entities.name: Anderson arrives at the Jolly Troll Tavern and approaches Carl and Gaear
entities.description: Anderson, identifying himself as Jerry Lundegaard, enters the bar and approaches a booth where two men, Carl Showalter and Gaear Grimsrud, are waiting, initiating a tense conversation about a planned arrangement.

entities.name: Jerry disputes the meeting time with Carl Showalter
entities.description: Jerry explains that he believed the meeting was scheduled for 8:30, contrary to Carl's claim that it was set for 7:30, leading to frustration over having waited an hour.

entities.name: Jerry confirms the availability of the car in the parking lot
entities.description: Jerry informs Carl and Gaear that the vehicle they were expecting—a brand-new burnt umber Ciera—is parked outside, confirming a key part of their arrangement.

entities.name: Carl introduces himself and his associate Gaear Grimsrud
entities.description: Carl Showalter introduces himself and the silent, dour man sitting with him, Gaear Grimsrud, establishing their identities to Jerry during the meeting at the booth.

entities.name: Jerry expresses confidence in Carl and Gaear based on Shep Proudfoot's recommendation
entities.description: Jerry states that he trusts the two men because Shep Proudfoot vouched for them, though the atmosphere remains tense as they stare at him without response.

entities.name: Jerry hands over the car keys to Carl and Gaear
entities.description: After an awkward pause, Jerry produces and offers the keys to the vehicle, finalizing the transfer and signaling the conclusion of their meeting.

entities.name: Meeting At The Jolly Troll Tavern
entities.description: A clandestine meeting takes place in a booth at the Jolly Troll Tavern between Jerry Lundegaard and two men, Carl Showalter and Gaear Grimsrud, to discuss and execute a planned arrangement involving a vehicle.

entities.description: A man involved in a criminal arrangement who arrives late to a meeting at the Jolly Troll Tavern and disputes the meeting time with Carl Showalter.
entities.summary: A car salesman disputes pricing with a customer, while another man under financial strain arranges a urgent deal with Wade, receives threats, and later resists arrest at a motel; the dealership's sales manager shows anxiety during a police inquiry.

entities.name: Carl Showalter
entities.description: A short, slight, youngish man who waits at the tavern with his associate and confronts Jerry about his late arrival.
entities.summary: Multiple men are involved in a criminal plot in a snowy setting, including one injured with a briefcase of money, another at a motel with accomplices, a dead man found dismembered, and others discussing plans or observing a performance, all interconnected through crime and tension.

entities.name: Gaear Grimsrud
entities.description: An older, dour man who is present at the meeting as Carl Showalter's associate and remains silent during the conversation.
entities.summary: A quiet, imposing man is involved in a criminal scheme with Carl Showalter, expressing hunger and a desire to stop at Pancakes Hause, while also being present at a motel with prostitutes and later entering a house masked and getting injured.

entities.name: Shep Proudfoot
entities.description: A person who recommended Carl and Gaear to Jerry and communicated the meeting time, though there is a discrepancy in what was relayed.

entities.name: Burnt Umber Ciera
entities.description: A brand-new car located in the snowswept parking lot that Jerry confirms is available for Carl and Gaear.
entities.summary: A brand-new car located in the snowswept parking lot that Jerry confirms is available for Carl and Gaear.

entities.name: car keys
entities.description: Keys handed over by Jerry to Carl and Gaear to transfer access to the vehicle involved in their arrangement.

entities.name: Carl clarifies the deal terms involving the new vehicle and forty thousand dollars
entities.description: Carl explains to Jerry that the agreement includes both a new vehicle and forty thousand dollars, expressing confusion over the arrangement and questioning its logic.

entities.name: Jerry explains the ransom plan is not self-financed
entities.description: Jerry clarifies that he is not paying the ransom himself, revealing that his wealthy father-in-law is the intended source of the money, motivated by his financial troubles and strained family dynamics.

entities.name: Gaear Grimsrud questions Jerry about asking his wife or father-in-law for money
entities.description: Gaear, speaking for the first time, sarcastically suggests Jerry ask his wife or father-in-law directly for the money, highlighting the absurdity of the kidnapping scheme.

entities.name: Jerry justifies his inability to request money from his family
entities.description: Jerry explains that his financial need is unknown to his wife and father-in-law, and even if they knew, they would not provide the money, framing the kidnapping plot as a necessary solution due to these personal barriers.

entities.name: Gaear Grimsrud
entities.description: A dour man with a Swedish accent who is associated with Carl Showalter and speaks during the meeting at the Jolly Troll Tavern.
entities.summary: A silent, smoking passenger in a car from Brainerd to Minneapolis, involved in violence: threatening a bound woman, attacking a trooper, shooting an injured man and a trapped woman, and assisting Jean at a cabin despite her restraints.
